criterion: Error codes distinguish usage from outage
description: Every control `cli` refusal, including usage mistakes such as a protected flag, an unknown harness or a lifecycle command, is coded `CONTROL_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE`, the same code an agent would see when the service is down.
expected: Usage refusals use INVALID_ARGUMENT/FORBIDDEN; CONTROL_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE is reserved for an unverifiable or stopped service.
suggested_fix: Give ControlError a code and map guard refusals to INVALID_ARGUMENT.

description: Running `control` in a directory that is not an installation (no config.json) prints `Control runtime: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '…/config.json'` (and the same raw text inside the cli JSON envelope).
expected: 'This is not a Pardner control installation (no config.json in HOME); set PARDNER_CONTROL_HOME or run from the installation'.
suggested_fix: Catch FileNotFoundError for config.json in Controller.__init__ and raise a ControlError with guidance.
